submitted.rationale: XRD shows the trirutile-type MgSb2O6 phase (Q≈1.91, 2.78, 3.22, 4.55, 5.33) along the whole line. The Sb-rich end also has an extra Sb-oxide phase (Q 2.45, 3.65). EQE rose from #23 (0.00043%) to #26 (0.00106%), and #25 was highest at 0.00134%. The best composition is Sb-rich, Mg0.27Sb0.73.
